if: input tax credit is claimed on a supply of goods or services or both
the registered person has NOT received the goods or services or both
then: credit of that input tax is DENIED
note: Receipt, not invoicing and not payment. An advance paid against a future supply carries no credit until the supply is received. Deemed receipt in the bill-to/ship-to case is governed separately by the Explanation — see GST-ITC-16-2-B-EXPL. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: he has received the goods or services or both.
